user.title: Swiss Transport
user.description: Choose what to add: an arrival/departure board of a station, or a saved connection (from → to) — e.g. your daily commute.

station.title: Search a station
station.description: Type part of the station name to search.

pick.title: Pick the station
pick.description: Choose the exact stop, how many departures to show, and optionally limit the transport types.

data_description.ojp_token: Optional. Paste an Open Journey Planner (OJP 2.0) API token from opentransportdata.swiss to add fresher delays, cancellations, platform changes and occupancy. Leave empty to use opendata.ch only.

connection.title: Connection: from and to
connection.description: Type part of both station names to search.

connection_pick.title: Pick origin and destination
connection_pick.description: Choose the exact stops and how many connections to show.

abort.already_configured: This station or connection is already configured.

error.cannot_connect: transport.opendata.ch or opentransportdata.swiss could not be reached.
error.invalid_auth: opentransportdata.swiss rejected the real-time token (HTTP 401/403). Check the token in its API Manager, or leave the field empty.
error.no_stations_found: No station found for this name.

data_description.ojp_token: Optional OJP 2.0 API token from opentransportdata.swiss for fresher delays, cancellations, platform changes and occupancy. Entered once, it enriches every station board. Leave empty to use opendata.ch only.

error.cannot_connect: opentransportdata.swiss could not be reached, so the token could not be checked. Try again later.
error.invalid_auth: opentransportdata.swiss rejected the real-time token (HTTP 401/403). Check the token in its API Manager, or leave the field empty.

get_departures.name: Get departures
get_departures.description: Returns the next departures at a stop: line, destination, platform, delay and departure time, as the departure-board sensor shows them.

station.name: Stop
station.description: Name of the stop (the first match of the timetable's station search is used) or its numeric station id.

transportations.name: Transport types
transportations.description: Only these types of transport; empty for all.

get_connections.name: Get connections
get_connections.description: Returns the next connections between two stops: departure and arrival, duration, transfers and the lines used.

from.name: From
from.description: Name or station id of the departure stop.

to.name: To
to.description: Name or station id of the destination stop.

limit.name: Number
limit.description: How many connections to return (each call counts against the API's daily quota of 1000 connection requests).

api_unreachable.message: The timetable service could not be reached.

rate_limited.message: The timetable service is refusing further requests for now (daily quota reached or too many requests).

departure_delayed.name: Next departure delayed
departure_delayed.description: Triggers when the next departure of a stop (or the next connection of a saved route) is delayed by at least the given number of minutes.

disruption_reported.name: Disruption reported
disruption_reported.description: Triggers when a disruption message appears for a stop (real-time source only).
